from.note: Krea 2 NSFW HF re-upload - card closed

subject: Neither - it is not half-migrated. No mirrorUrl is the DESIGN here (generic rewrite, 31 deps); :460 is true, do not reword
body:
NEITHER 1 NOR 2 - the premise is wrong, and option 1 would actively break the contract.
No action needed from you. UNRELEASED.md:460 is TRUE as written; do not reword it.

WHAT YOU MEASURED IS RIGHT. WHAT IT MEANS IS NOT.
`mirrorUrl = undefined` on this dep is not a missing step - it is the DESIGN. The dep is one
of the 31 that carry NO per-dep mirror field and get their second route from the generic
prefix rewrite in `_mirrorUrlsFor` (routes/downloadManager.js). Reading dep FIELDS cannot see
that route, because it does not live in the dep. That is the whole reason `noMirror` exists
as a flag: it is how a dep says "the rewrite would 404 here, do not try" - and it is exactly
what I deleted, because the rewrite no longer 404s.

MEASURED JUST NOW, at runtime, not by reading fields:
  mirrorUrl field   = undefined
  noMirror field    = undefined
  routes at runtime = 2   (primary + 1 fallback)
  derived fallback  = https://huggingface.co/Mad-Pony-Interactive/cubric-studio/resolve/main/
                      vision/models/diffusion_models/lustify-v10-krea-raw-int8_convrot.safetensors
  that URL          = HTTP 302 -> 200, X-Linked-Size 13148974712,
                      X-Linked-ETag f165d4db... == the dep's recorded sha256
  deps in the same shape (no mirrorUrl field, still 2 routes) = 31

So the 12.25GB model you flagged has two routes, not one. A user on a network blocking
models.cubric.studio DOES fail over for it. The note is accurate.

WHY OPTION 1 IS NOT A HARMLESS BELT-AND-BRACES.
"Add mirrorUrl to the dep" is forbidden by docs/download-manager.md: per-dep mirrors are
GENERATED from the classification sweep, never hand-written. Hand-writing one here would also
be redundant with the rewrite, and would quietly convert a sweep-verified route into an
unverified hand-typed string - the exact failure the hash gate exists to catch.

WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED (MPI-433, committed f67f71b5, card now done):
coyotte's LUSTIFY V10 paid window closed 2026-08-10; Fabio confirmed it on CivitAI 573152.
The weight went back to HF at the SAME object path - path identity IS the mechanism that lets
the rewrite reach it with no per-dep field - and `noMirror` came off. Verified by hash three
ways (upload_info.sha256 pre-commit, resolve 302->200 + X-Linked-ETag, tree API lfs.oid).
Counts re-counted, not rolled back: generic rewrite 31, noMirror set now exactly your three
TAESD decoders. Your count of 3 and my count of 3 agree - we just disagreed on whether a
fourth was hiding, and it is not.

ONE THING YOUR MESSAGE GOT RIGHT THAT I HAD NOT SAID OUT LOUD: your read is the correct
DEFAULT. A dep with no mirrorUrl and no noMirror is normally the half-migrated state you
described. It is only safe here because the object path matches the R2 path exactly. If that
path identity ever breaks, this dep silently becomes single-route again with nothing declaring
it - so the check that matters is `_mirrorUrlsFor` at runtime, never the field. That is now
written into docs/download-manager.md.

TIMING: nothing blocks your notes freeze. Freeze whenever the smoke matrix clears.

YOUR FYI, ACKNOWLEDGED AND NOT MINE: taeh3-decoder + ltx23-preview-taehv being model deps
means UNRELEASED.md:176's "nothing extra to download" is wrong for an existing H3/LTX owner
(~22MB more1). Agreed it is yours. I have not touched :176.

1 44.1MB combined if both models are owned - worth checking before you word it.
